normalAttackEffects.name: Attack
normalAttackEffects.originalDescription: Each time damage is dealt to enemies, boosted basic attack gauge increases. When the boosted basic attack gauge is full (after 8 instances of damage), the Pokémon's basic attacks become boosted attacks. Becomes boosted attacks when the boosted attack gauge is full, dealing increased damage in an area of effect centered on the opposing Pokémon they hit. Each time the user deals damage to opposing Pokémon, the boosted attack gauge increases by 1, becoming full when the user deals damage 8 times. After not dealing damage for 3s, the boosted attack gauge decreases by 2 every 0.5s.

uniteMoveEffects.name: Dreep and Destroy
uniteMoveEffects.originalDescription: Launches two Dreepy and each deals damage to different Pokémon in the area of effect. The lower the opposing Pokémon's remaining HP is, the more damage the Dreepy deal. If there is only one target in the area of effect, both Dreepy target that Pokémon and deal damage to it. A maximum of 2 uses can be kept in reserve for this move. Dreepy may be fired once every 2 seconds. Neither Cooldown Reduction nor gaining Aeos Energy reduce the cooldown of Dreep and Destroy. The user launches two Dreepy at up to 2 different opposing Pokémon in range, damaging them and dealing additional missing HP damage to each target. If there is only one target in range, the second Dreepy deals 30% of the full damage to the target. A maximum of 2 uses can be kept in reserve for this Unite Move; there is a 2s cooldown between uses for this move. Against wild Pokémon: additional missing HP damage is capped at 1200. Unite buffs: 10% Max HP Shield, 10% Movement Speed for 3s; Has an internal cooldown of 30s to activate Energy Amplifier; Has an internal cooldown of 60s to activate Buddy Barrier;
